split.dev_frauds: kept out of training and of the threshold

game_day.description: Day 2 of the test set: three 8 h shifts (time = seconds since the first transaction of the dataset).

shifts.name: Shift 1: day 2, hours 0-8 from dataset start
Shift 2: day 2, hours 8-16 from dataset start
Shift 3: day 2, hours 16-24 from dataset start

currency.note: The dataset has no currency; amounts are treated as EUR (assumption). The game converts to PLN with its own exchange-rate assumption.

models.name: VAE
models.description: I trained a variational autoencoder on legit card transactions only. It scores each transaction by how badly it can rebuild it from 8 numbers, so unusual transactions score high.
models.score_rule: mean squared reconstruction error, decoded from z_mean (deterministic)
models.threshold_rule: 99th percentile of the scores of legit calibration transactions (notebook)

metrics.selection: median run by PR AUC (lower middle run for an even number of runs)

models.name: PCA baseline
models.description: For comparison, the PCA baseline rebuilds each transaction from 8 principal components and scores it the same way.
models.score_rule: mean squared reconstruction error of 8 principal components
models.threshold_rule: 99th percentile of the scores of legit calibration transactions (notebook)
